title: 第1030章 城市在移动第1029章 地火失控
slug: 聚宝仙锅第1038章天龟肆虐
content_zh:
城主？
身穿白色铠甲威风凛凛的男子？
恐怕，只有李凡了解内幕。
易容！
这城主的易容术，实在是太高明了！
易容术，最难的一种，便是跨越性别。
李凡深有体会，自己还是低级修士的时候，也易容成一位小丫鬟。
当时，李凡就差点几次都露馅。
跨性别的易容，难点不是在易容的宝物上，而是举止，还有声音。
尤其是声音，必须有这方面的天赋。
变换声线，也需要有一定的天赋。
还好！
李凡在这方面的天赋还算可以。
还算可以？
没错，对于李凡来说，尤其是没有脱胎换骨之前，在修炼方面的天赋，实在是有限。
往往修炼什么，或者是领悟什么法诀，必须依靠自己坚韧的性格，反复尝试，在无数次失败后，才能勉强过关。
还好，这样的日子，已经彻底过去。
五次脱胎换骨后的李凡，感官异常敏感，领悟力同样有质的飞跃。
说回当下。
这威风凛凛的城主，正是小姑娘易容而成的。

小姑娘，正是和自己一起在千味宗秘境寻宝的队员。
死而复生？
完全可以这么说。
这小姑娘，不止手段高明，还实力强悍，背景深厚。
否则，天贵城的城主，可不是那么好当的。
所以，小姑娘不得不易容一下，如果以本来面目示人，恐怕难以服众。
却说，所有现场的金丹老祖，施展各种水系法术。
四十几位金丹老祖同时施法。
可以想象一下，那种壮观的场面，是多么的震撼。
难得！
对于一般的低级修士，一辈子都不会看到如此浩瀚的场景。
这，也是一种机缘。
本来，准备逃离的低级修士，包括一些筑基期修士，都不由自主的聚集过来。
修士们都死死盯着这壮丽的场景，都想通过观摩金丹老祖的震撼法术，得到一点启发，可以对自己的修炼，起到一定领悟和推动的作用。
“这？”
李凡无语的苦笑。
所有人的注意力，都在施法的四十几个金丹老祖身上。
这位表面看起来格外庄重的城主，竟然对李凡眨了一下眼睛。
晕！
content_en:
City lord?
A majestic man wearing white armor?
I'm afraid, only Li Fan knows the inside story.
Disguise!
This city lord's disguise technique is really brilliant!
The most difficult form of disguise is to cross gender.
Li Fan has a deep understanding that when he was a low-level monk, he also disguised himself as a maid.
At that time, Li Fan almost had his secret revealed several times.
The difficulty in cross-gender disguise is not the treasure of the disguise, but the behavior and voice.
Especially the voice, you must have talent in this area.
Changing the voice also requires a certain amount of talent.
fine!
Li Fan's talent in this area is pretty good.
Not bad?
Yes, for Li Fan, especially before he was reborn, his talent in cultivation was really limited.
Often, to practice something or to understand any magic formula, you must rely on your own tenacity and try repeatedly. Only after countless failures can you barely pass the test.
Fortunately, these days are over.
After being reborn five times, Li Fan has extremely sensitive senses and a qualitative leap in comprehension.
Back to the present.
This majestic city lord was made by the little girl in disguise.
The little girl was the team member who was hunting for treasure in the secret realm of Qianweizong with him.
Resurrection from the dead?
That's absolutely true.
This little girl is not only smart, but also powerful and has a profound background.
Otherwise, being the city lord of Tiangui City would not be that easy.
Therefore, the little girl had to change her appearance. If she showed her true colors, she might not be able to convince the public.
But he said that all the Jindan ancestors on the scene cast various water spells.
More than forty Jindan ancestors cast spells at the same time.
You can imagine how shocking that spectacular scene is.
rare!
For ordinary low-level monks, they will never see such a vast scene in their lifetime.
This is also an opportunity.
Originally, the low-level monks who were preparing to escape, including some foundation-building monks, gathered involuntarily.
The monks all stared at this magnificent scene, hoping to get some inspiration by observing the shocking spells of the ancestor of the Golden Pill, which could help them understand and promote their own cultivation.
"This?"
Li Fan smiled silently.
Everyone's attention was on the forty or so Jindan ancestors who were casting spells.
The city lord, who looked particularly solemn on the surface, actually blinked at Li Fan.
faint!
